changelog:
- Initial release of the yt-mem-ai entry point skill.
- Provides a unified interface to drive all yt-mem-ai YouTube CLI operations: ingest, discover, search, recommend, summarize, and manage configuration.
- Clear instructions for all core commands, including single/batch video ingestion, querying, rating, compiling highlights, generating supercuts, and handling common errors.
- Emphasizes correct usage: never touch the store directly, always use the CLI, and always quote URLs.
- Includes troubleshooting tips for common YouTube blocks and configuration instructions.
summary: Use when the user wants to run any yt-ai operation from Claude Code — ingest a video, discover subscription uploads, batch-fetch pending, search the library, rate/recommend, compile highlights, build a supercut, check status, or run a full pipeline (daily routine or single-video). The umbrella entry point for the yt-mem-ai CLI; delegates per-video analysis, digests, and reviews to [[yt-agent]].
